description: a cylinder of radius 1.5 (z 0..1) fused with a cylinder of radius 0.3 (z -1..2) whose axis is 1.2 from the first's in the direction 1e-4 rad off the seam, so the inner wall touches the outer's along one ruling a hair off both seams, and stands out of both ends. The closed form: V = 2.25 pi + 0.27 pi - 0.09 pi = 2.43 pi and A = 3 pi (outer wall) + 2 (2.25 - 0.09) pi (outer caps) + 2 pi 0.3 2 (inner wall outside the slab) + 2 0.09 pi (inner ends) = 8.7 pi. The inner seam crosses each outer cap 3e-9 inside the rim, within its tolerance and 3e-5 from the touch, so the crossing is a vertex of the rim as well, and the outer seam's ends, within the tolerance of the inner wall, are vertices of the section circles (the retired tangency-faults plan). Each cap is a crescent from the touch to the outer seam's vertex; the rim's pieces between the seams and the touch bound the inner wall's pieces outside the slab, and the inner seam, lying on the outer wall, splits it into two faces, a strip 1.2e-4 wide between the seams and the rest, stated in counts_differ

analytic.counts_differ: Arris imprints the inner wall's seam where it lies on the outer wall within the tolerance, 1.2e-4 from the outer seam, so the outer wall is two faces, and each crescent cap runs between the touch and the outer seam's vertex, the rim cut at the touch and at the inner seam's crossing (8/14/8/8); Open CASCADE's fuse has 6/10/6/6
